newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Mediaset names executive committee.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Mediaset names executive committee.

text.p: The board of Italian private broadcaster Mediaset said it had created a new six-member executive committee and had named chief financial officer Michele Preda to the board.
The committee will consist of chairman Fedele Confalonieri, managing directors Giuliano Adreani, Carlo Bernasconi and Adriano Galliani, as well as Gilberto Doni and Preda, a Mediaset statement said.
Preda replaces Italo Riccio on the board of Mediaset, which is controlled by former Italian prime minister Silvio Berlusconi's media groop Fininvest Spa.
Mediaset said it had also decided to exercise an option to purchase the television rights of 40 cinema titles from Medusa Film, the cinema asset holding of the Fininvest group.
The films, which will be distributed in the 1997-98 season, will enter the Mediaset film library two years after their first showing at the cinema.
